Title: DarkStrata Credential Check for Umbraco Automate
Description: Adds a Compromised Credential Detected trigger to Umbraco Automate. When DarkStrata Credential Check finds a member or backoffice login or password change in the DarkStrata breach corpus, the trigger starts your automation with the source, email, user id and time, so editors can alert the security team, open a ticket or call a webhook without writing code. Hits for the same user start at most one run per five-minute window, so a brute-force attempt does not flood your alerts. Requires DarkStrata.CredentialCheck.Umbraco, Umbraco 17.4 or later and Umbraco Automate 17.

AuthorDetails.Name: DarkStrata
AuthorDetails.Description: DarkStrata is a threat intelligence company. We track credentials exposed in breaches and infostealer logs, and make them queryable so teams can stop the ones that matter before they are used.
